review.notes: Full review. Gate at d42952a passes every check, but its depcheck sees 0 edges because the README has no *Needs:* lines or supplier headings: by hand, KacMoody (merge order line 2) consumes QuantumEnvelopingAlgebras (282), TensorProductCombinatorics (275) and FormalConnectionsOpers (39) while QuantumEnvelopingAlgebras' open head cites KacMoody KM0 as its input (cycle, P1). KM1's invariant form is claimed nondegenerate and complement-independent for every KM0 realization; false for non-minimal realizations (A1 with a 2- or 3-dimensional Cartan), P2. Suggested.lean states no headline theorem although the Weyl-Kac formula is statable on its own Verma carrier, P2. Sampled 15 targets: 4 cited texts read (Lenart-Postnikov, Chirivi-Fang-Littelmann, Kanakubo, Sagaki abstract) and agree; Kac, Lusztig, Littelmann 1994/1995, Kashiwara 1991 and the unidentified 'Algebraic Varieties in Representation Theory' are not legally readable. Adversarial table of 26 rows with computed values; Mathlib residue-pairing sign, Serre construction, Cartan realisation and the four Tau Ceti Coxeter declarations checked at the pins; Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning; one-tactic probe closes none of the three sorried theorems.
